title: CTO Realty Growth, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-29
summary: CTO Realty Growth, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 29, 2026 disclosing the execution of Preferred Equity Distribution Agreements with Cantor Fitzgerald and Huntington Securities, Inc. to serve as additional sales agents in the company's at-the-market preferred stock offering program, which has an aggregate offering price of up to $25,000,000. The company also entered into separate Common Equity Distribution Agreements with the same parties for an at-the-market common stock offering program with an aggregate offering price of up to $250,000,000.
key_points: CTO Realty Growth added Cantor Fitzgerald and Huntington Securities as sales agents to its ATM preferred stock program.
Preferred stock program ceiling: $25,000,000 aggregate offering price for 6.375% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock.
Common stock program ceiling: $250,000,000 aggregate offering price for common stock.
The company also amended existing equity distribution agreements with seven prior agents (AGP, B. Riley, Baird, Jefferies, Jones, Raymond James, Truist) to account for the new participants.
Both preferred and common equity distribution agreements are in substantially identical forms to existing agreements.
The filing does not constitute an offer to sell or solicitation to buy securities in any jurisdiction where such would be unlawful.
